categories.main_business_segments: Earth Corporation operates two main business segments: the Household Products Business and the Comprehensive Environmental Hygiene Business. The Household Products segment includes insect control products, oral care, bath additives, daily necessities, pet care, and gardening products. The Comprehensive Environmental Hygiene segment provides hygiene management services for factories, hospitals, and large facilities, focusing on pest control, cleaning, disinfection, and consulting services for food, pharmaceutical, and packaging industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary chemical formulations and manufacturing processes for insecticides, repellents, and hygiene products, emphasizing safety, efficacy, and user convenience. R&D focuses on rapid product development, high-quality standards, and environmental sustainability, including eco-friendly packaging and plant-based ingredients. In the environmental hygiene segment, advanced inspection, microbial testing, and digital technologies (IoT, AI) are used for hygiene management and consulting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include mass retailers, drugstores, wholesalers, and specialty stores for household products, as well as food, pharmaceutical, and packaging manufacturers, hospitals, and large commercial facilities for hygiene services. Major end markets are general consumers (for daily necessities and pet care) and B2B clients in regulated industries requiring stringent hygiene standards.
categories.geographic_coverage: Earth Corporation operates primarily in Japan, with significant overseas operations in Asia (notably Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, the Philippines, and China). Products are exported to about 50 countries and regions, with growing sales in ASEAN, the Middle East, Taiwan, and North America. The company maintains manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in key Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned downstream in the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of branded consumer products and hygiene services. It also manages some upstream activities such as R&D and procurement of raw materials, and midstream activities like contract manufacturing and quality control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include overseas sales expansion, especially in high-growth ASEAN markets, supply chain optimization, and brand portfolio rationalization. R&D emphasizes high-value-added, safe, and sustainable products, digital transformation (IT/DX), and the development of eco-friendly and health-oriented solutions. The company is also pursuing group synergies through M&A and organizational restructuring, and investing in human capital and sustainability initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured and branded products (insecticides, daily necessities, pet care, etc.) to retailers and wholesalers, as well as through service contracts for environmental hygiene management. Some products are sold via direct export, and a portion of revenue comes from B2B hygiene consulting and recurring service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other large Japanese and global consumer goods companies in the insecticide, oral care, and daily necessities sectors, such as KINCHO, Lion, Kao, and P&G. In the environmental hygiene segment, competitors include specialized hygiene and facility management firms. Earth Corporation holds a leading market share in insect control products in Japan and is aiming for top share in Thailand, with a strong brand presence and diversified portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For FY2024, consolidated net sales were ¥169.3 billion (approx. $1.1 billion), with operating profit of ¥6.4 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥3.5 billion. The company employs nearly 4,900 people. Sales have shown steady growth (6.9% YoY in 2024), with a strategic target of ¥170 billion in sales and ¥7 billion in operating profit by 2026. Overseas sales account for about 13% of total revenue and are expected to increase.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Earth Corporation differentiates itself through high-quality, safe, and innovative products tailored to consumer needs, with a strong focus on environmental sustainability and social responsibility. Its insect control products are market leaders, supported by proprietary technology and strong branding. The company emphasizes customer-centric product development, rapid response to market trends, and comprehensive hygiene solutions for both consumers and businesses.
